alex: Heads up — I ran a perf sweep with paged-KV + fused-attn (QKV pack + bias/rope epilogue fusion) on nv4 and saw a consistent P99 regression of ~12-18% for short sequences (<=64) on small batches.
maya: Oof. Is the regression across batch sizes or just small batches? any perf counters?
alex: Mostly batch 1-4. Attaching quick profiler snippet and flame summary:
```
FusedAttn::epilogue   45.3% wait_mem
QKVPack               20.1% compute
L2_miss_rate          2.1x baseline
active_warps          24 -> 31 during epilogue
page_faults           ~0.02% (paged-kv active)
```
maya: That looks like the epilogue is getting stalled waiting on kvcache loads/page handling. Could be our liveness/barrier code after adding bias+rope fusion.
igor: I recall we added an extra atomic fence in the fused epilogue to avoid double-free when a page miss triggers an async refill. That could serialize warps and blow up P99 for short seqs.
maya: Two quick experiments to triage:
1) disable the liveness fence in the fused epilogue (unsafe but for perf test only)
2) reduce QKV pack region threshold (pack_size) from 128 -> 64 so small sequences avoid the fused path
can run both A/B on canary GPUs.
sam: I'll run both experiments on infra-canary-1 (nv4) and collect microbench (batch sizes 1/2/4, seq 8/32/64). Will post numbers in this thread.
deploybot: deploybot: canary rollout started: branch infra/fusion-backoff-test -> infra-canary-1
alex: Proposal for a low-risk runtime heuristic (fusion_safe_backoff):
- if paged_kv enabled AND seq <= 64 AND batch <= 4
- measure runtime metrics during warmup: active_warps, l2_miss_rate
- if active_warps > 28 OR l2_miss_rate > 1.5x baseline -> fallback to unfused-epilogue for that request
This keeps fused path for long seqs/large batches while avoiding P99 regressions on tiny requests.
maya: Add metrics/alerts: epilogue_wait_ms, active_warps, l2_miss_ratio; trigger regression alert if P99 latency up >10% over baseline for 15m.
igor: Sounds good. Also add a unit test simulating kvcache stall (fake sleep in page fill path) to verify fallback triggers deterministically.
sam: Will implement feature-flagged change + canary run. Tagging reviewers: @igor for code, @maya for metrics. Aiming to merge behind flag if canary P99 <= 5% regression.
alex: :thumbsup: assign to sam. Let's try to get this staged by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all.
